notes.title: WotG Released! How to change your language!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25759596/8d188d4d136519a3e41b114691a7d14bcc3ac631.jpg[/img]

Dear Players,

We've just launched Will of the Gods! As exciting it is for us, mere seconds after launching we encountered a bug - the default language set for everyone seems to be Russian!

Here is a quick fix that you can do yourself, while we work to fix the bug:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25759596/b9ea2ff4f8f2d13af2c897ce9670e0d624948a70.jpg[/img]

We're terribly sorry for the inconvenience, but bugs can pop-up in the most unusual ways! We're hot-fixing the issue as we speak.

Play on!

We'd like to also give a big shoutout to all the people that voted for us on Steam Greenlight, the awesome devs over at the Facepunch GameDev thread, our followers on Twitter and naturally, for anyone interesed enough in our game to read this!
